OCP070.limits: No absolute activity energies/thermal RC/retention acceleration curve; maximum stack height is not actual product die count. Online download403 superseded by committed local original PDF.

SANDISK202507.derivation: 16 * 256e9 bits /8 =512e9 bytes; decimal GB per footnote
SANDISK202507.limits: Manufacturer product targets, not measured HBF. No absolute heat/energy parameters. General no-refresh-power wording does not settle OCP maintenance conditions.

MICRONHBM4.limits: Specific product capabilities. Byte convention/density, JEDEC channels/pseudochannels and absolute thermal/refresh energies pending. 8Gbps config point is ASSUMED, not a quoted guaranteed operating point.

FIXTURE.definition: Positive arbitrary lumped RC network and synthetic energy impulses for software/numerical invariants
FIXTURE.limits: No geometry calibration, no realistic temperature/performance/retention prediction.

DASH.definition: GPU-HBM, GPU-HBF, HBM-base-die-HBF paths; relay bypasses DRAM cells
DASH.limits: Four-pair HBM4 topology is an explicit architecture extension, not published physical device. Paper KV-writeback/GC assumptions are not adopted into OCP read-only-weight main scenario.

HEATWATCH.limits: Measured source3D-NAND, not targetHBF; confidence interval is not HBF uncertainty.85C extrapolates beyond fit temperature. P1 does not activate reliability.
